description:
T1 - Sycamore
To reduce height and spread back to previous pruning points (approx. 2.5m)
To remove large amount of basal and epicormic growth to a height of 4m. 
To crown raise lower canopy to a height of 3.5-4m above ground level, over footpaths and driveways and to a height of 5.5m over the carriageway. 
To remove dead and damaged material from crown. 
To thin canopy by approx. 20% to increase light and airflow through canopy.
To reduce encroachment into neighbouring property 29 Station Rd by approx. 2m. 
To remove all arisings.

Reasons - To keep size manageable and suitable for location. To clear encroaching growth into public highway and footpath. To decrease encroaching growth onto buiding. To increase light and airflow throughout canopy.

T2 - Sycamore
To reduce entire crown to near previous cuts approx. 2.5m and reshape to balance.
To remove basal and epicormic growth. 
To crown raise to a height of 4 m. 
To remove dead and damaged material from crown. 
To thin canopy by approx. 10% to increase light and airflow through canopy.
To cut back encroachment to building to leave a 2m clearance where possible. 
To remove all arisings

Reasons - To keep size manageable and suitable for location. To clear encroaching growth into public highway and footpath. To clear access driveway into Speights Court. To increase light and airflow throughout canopy.
